title: Growth
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.139 Numbered Discourses 3.139
  • 14. Yodhājīvavagga 14. A Warrior

Vuddhisutta Growth

“Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vuddhiyo. “Mendicants, there are three kinds of growth. Katamā tisso? What three? Saddhāvuddhi, sīlavuddhi, paññāvuddhi—Growth in faith, ethics, and wisdom. imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vuddhiyo”ti. These are the three kinds of growth.”

Sattamaṁ.
